items.note: Often pairs with a question like もう〜ましたか ("have you already...?"), answered with まだです below ("not yet").
The negative answer to a もう〜ましたか question ("have you already...?") above — "not yet."
A fixed phrase for "soon, shortly" — not compositional with もう ("already") above; don't read it as "already soon."
A fixed phrase for "a little more/longer" — not compositional with もう ("already") above.
Before a noun, なにか means "some" or "any": なにか うんどう (nanika undō, "any kind of exercise"). On its own it means "something" (Lesson 16).
